file_purpose: Research and evidence profile for University of Leicester A100 Medicine MBChB standard entry. This file preserves the supplied Leicester 2027-entry research pack and A100 2027 Scoring Document; executable rules live in data/universities/leicester-a100.json.

manual_review_scope: graduate_a100_numeric_ranking (degree-classification and best-3-A-level scoring formula is official but not executed by the shared generic scoring engine)
access_to_medicine_numeric_ranking (76-point References/Personal-statement Admissions-Tutor scoring is not executable without human-scored inputs)
home_schooled_applicants (manual further-detail review, no published formula)
research_scope.notes: Implementation covers the officially published Step 2/3/4 eligibility gates and the officially published Section 4.1/4.2/6.0 GCSE and UCAT scoring formulae for the predicted A-level pool (Home and International, ranked separately). Achieved A-level auto-interview, Access to Medicine and Graduate routes use eligibility gates only; Graduate and Access numeric ranking require manual review because their scoring inputs (degree classification bonus interactions and Admissions-Tutor-scored references/personal statement) are not supported by the shared generic scoring engine.

evidence_classification_policy.OFFICIAL: Stated directly by the University of Leicester in the supplied 2027-entry research pack or the A100 2027 Scoring Document.
evidence_classification_policy.HISTORICAL: Official 2026-entry admissions statistics and combined-score guarantee thresholds, used as historical guidance only, not a current-cycle guarantee.
evidence_classification_policy.ESTIMATE: ApplySmart modelling or derived interpretation. Not an official Leicester rule.
evidence_classification_policy.UNVERIFIED: Third-party or applicant-reported material not suitable for production logic.
evidence_classification_policy.UNAVAILABLE: A source or value identified as unpublished in the supplied research.

route_limited_blockers: Graduate A100 numeric ranking (best-3 A-level plus degree-classification formula) is official but not executed by the shared generic scoring engine; graduate eligibility is executable, ranking is manual review.
Access to Medicine numeric ranking (76-point formula including Admissions-Tutor-scored references and personal statement) requires human-scored inputs and is manual review.
Scottish Advanced Higher plus Higher joint evaluation remains a generic-classifier manual-review boundary.
Country-specific international qualification equivalence (ECCTIS case-by-case) is not encoded.
Home-schooled applicant additional review has no published formula and is manual review.

Interaction between the two achieved-A-level academic bonus tracks (extra A*s vs strong 4th qualification above AAA) has no combined published worked example; both tracks are represented individually and the total academic score is capped at 48.
engine_execution_boundaries: Predicted A-level Home and International eligibility and GCSE(/48) + UCAT(/48) = /96 scoring can be checked where complete GCSE, A-level, UCAT and SJT evidence is supplied.

Achieved A-level applicants who meet every published auto-interview condition (first gap year, GCSE/A-level minimums at first sitting, UCAT top-5-decile Home / top-3-decile International, SJT Bands 1-3) receive a guaranteed-interview outcome instead of ordinary GCSE+UCAT banding.

AL Med, ROP, Sutton Trust and the 2027-restricted UKWPMED route receive the same guaranteed-interview outcome only when the applicant's verified programme-completion evidence is supplied; UKWPMED additionally requires first-gap-year and 2025-2026 programme-completion evidence.
SJT Band 4 is a deterministic not_eligible outcome for all school-leaver and Access routes, applied regardless of UCAT total score.
Applicants in the bottom two national UCAT deciles (below the 2nd-to-3rd-decile boundary in data/ucat-deciles.json) are excluded from scoring, not scored at zero.

2026-entry combined-score guarantee thresholds (79/96 Home predicted, 88/96 International predicted, 68/70 Home/International graduate predicted/achieved) are historical guidance only; only one year of directly comparable 96-point-scale data exists because of the 2025 UCAT rescale and Leicester's 2026 64pt-to-96pt scoring-scale change, so historical-trend confidence is Limited even though current-cycle eligibility and selection-methodology confidence is Medium-to-High.
readiness.summary: Official evidence supports scoped eligibility for all four applicant sub-groups and a fully executable GCSE+UCAT/96 scoring formula and historical guidance bands for the predicted A-level Home and International school-leaver pools. Achieved-route auto-interview and AL Med/ROP/Sutton Trust/UKWPMED guaranteed-interview routes are executable as eligibility overrides. Graduate and Access numeric ranking remain manual-review boundaries because their official formulae require inputs (degree-classification bonus interaction, Admissions-Tutor-scored references/personal statement) the shared generic scoring engine does not compute.

applicant_sub_groups.cross_cutting_dimension: International candidates are ranked only against other International candidates within each of the four groups; International is not a fifth group.
widening_participation_layer: UKWPMED (2027-entry restricted: first-gap-year applicants who completed the UKWPMED programme in the 2025-2026 academic year only)

steps: Check minimum GCSE/English/UCAT-validity eligibility gates for all candidates (Step 2.1).
Apply the SJT Band 4 automatic rejection and bottom-2-national-UCAT-decile exclusion (Step 3.0/4).

Score predicted-route and achieved-route (non-auto-interview) applicants on GCSE(/48) + UCAT(/48) = /96; score graduate applicants on best-3-A-level/HL(/48)+degree(/12) capped at /48; score Access applicants on the 76-point formula (Section 6.0).
Apply guaranteed-interview overrides for achieved-route auto-interview candidates and for verified AL Med/ROP/Sutton Trust/UKWPMED completers.

Rank remaining eligible applicants within each of the 4 sub-groups, Home and International ranked separately, highest-scoring invited to interview until capacity is reached; no fixed published quota per sub-group.

gcse.minimum_profile: Grade B/6 in English Language (as first language), Mathematics, and two sciences (Biology AND Chemistry, or Double Science). Equivalent accepted.
gcse.rare_exception: If Biology is held at A-level/IB HL but not GCSE, Chemistry + Physics GCSE may be considered instead, provided Biology is present at some level.
gcse.resit_policy: English Language and Mathematics resits accepted from any applicant. Other GCSE subject resits only with Mitigating Circumstances Panel approval; resits must already be completed at the time of application. First-sit results are scored, even if a later resit exists, except for a mandatory subject where the only sitting was the resit.
gcse.recency_requirement: Evidence of recent academic attainment within 3 years of the UCAS closing date; graduates of vocational professions may be considered later with evidence of ongoing professional development.

scoring_formula.applies_to: predicted A-level, achieved A-level (non-auto-interview) and IB route applicants
scoring_formula.double_science_alternative: Double Science may substitute for the Biology and Chemistry mandatory slots.
scoring_formula.additional_subjects: The four highest-scoring other subjects, excluding Citizenship Studies and Global Perspectives.
scoring_formula.maths_further_maths_rule: Only the higher-scoring of Mathematics or Further Mathematics/Statistics counts toward the additional-subject score, but the Mathematics slot must still separately clear grade 6/B at eligibility.

manual_review_boundaries: GCSE resits approved by the Mitigating Circumstances Panel (no fixed bonus-point value is published for accepted mitigation).

a_level.standard_offer: A*AA including Chemistry or Biology plus one of Biology/Chemistry/Physics/Mathematics/Psychology, excluding General Studies, Citizenship Studies, Critical Thinking and Global Perspectives.
a_level.predicted_scoring_floor: AAB predicted is the minimum required to be scored under the standard/contextual predicted routes; AAB is not itself an offer level.
alternative_offers: AAA (incl. 2 required science subjects) + EPQ grade B
AAA (incl. 2 required science subjects) + 4th-subject AS grade A
AAA (incl. 2 required science subjects) + Advanced Welsh Baccalaureate Skills Challenge Certificate grade B+
AAAB across 4 A-levels with the two science subjects at AA
a_level.maths_further_maths_rule: Do not consider both Mathematics and Further Mathematics together; only the higher grade counts toward the 3-subject requirement, and the Mathematics GCSE slot must still separately clear grade 6/B.
a_level.year_12_and_as_exclusion: A-levels sat in Year 12 do not count toward pre-interview selection, nor do 4th-subject AS levels, except achieved-AAA candidates or rare borderline-group cases.
a_level.three_year_completion: Candidates taking 3 years to complete first-sit A-levels are not normally considered, only with accepted Mitigating Circumstances Panel approval.
a_level.resit_policy: A-level resits only considered if the candidate held a conditional firm offer AND had Mitigating-Circumstances-Panel-accepted mitigation; otherwise rejected outright. Resitting candidates are pre-interview scored on GCSEs + UCAT only, plus whole-UCAS-form review.

third_language_a_level_offer_stage_note.detail: A 3rd A-level in a home/native language (not English Language) carries an adjusted offer of A*A*A with A* required in that language subject at offer stage.
third_language_a_level_offer_stage_note.reason_excluded_from_executable_logic: This is an offer-stage rule; ApplySmart is an interview-prediction engine and does not implement offer prediction.

home_schooled_applicants.detail: Home-schooled applicants are asked to submit further details and this is used as part of interview selection in addition to academic/UCAT scores, similarly to Access candidates. No published formula for how it is weighted.

achieved_a_level_auto_interview.condition: First gap year AND met all minimum GCSE/English requirements at first sitting AND achieved minimum A-level requirements within 2 years of GCSEs AND UCAT total in the top-5-decile (Home) or top-3-decile (International) national bracket AND SJT Bands 1-3.
achieved_a_level_auto_interview.outcome: Direct guaranteed interview; no further GCSE/UCAT scoring is applied.
achieved_a_level_auto_interview.non_qualifying_achieved_scoring: Otherwise scored using the GCSE(/48) formula plus UCAT(/48), plus bonus points, capped at 48.

bonus_points.extra_a_star_track: More than one A* at A-level: A*A*A = +1, A*A*A* = +2, and so on.
bonus_points.fourth_qualification_track: EPQ / 4th-subject AS / Advanced Welsh Baccalaureate Skills Challenge Certificate at grade B+: bonus for any result above AAA, e.g. A*AA=+1, A*A*A=+2.

interaction_between_tracks.handling: Both bonus tracks are represented individually. No combined worked example is published, so the interaction is not inferred; total academic score is capped at 48 regardless of bonuses applied.

second_gap_year.detail: Second gap year applicants are expected to show evidence of paid employment in a caring role (unless illness or mandatory national service).

international_baccalaureate.standard: 34 points with 7,6,6 at HL (7 in required science), OR 36 points with 6,6,6 at HL; HL subjects must include Chemistry or Biology plus one of Chemistry/Biology/Physics/Mathematics/Sports Science/Psychology.

sl_sub_requirements.detail: IB Standard-Level English/Mathematics sub-requirements are not separately published beyond the overall HL/points requirement.

scottish.highers_alone_not_accepted: Applicants offering only Scottish Highers are not considered.
scottish.advanced_higher_route: AAA (incl. Chemistry or Biology + one of Biology/Chemistry/Physics/Mathematics/Psychology), OR 2 sciences at Advanced Higher (AA) + 3 Highers (AAB).

national_5_note.detail: No Scotland-specific National 5 grade is separately published; the general GCSE-equivalent grade B/6 standard applies. No distinct Scottish contextual policy is published; general UK-wide contextual criteria apply.

graduate_a100.minimum_requirements: Minimum upper-second-class (2:1) honours degree (achieved or predicted), any discipline, provided minimum GCSE requirements are met and grade B in Chemistry or Biology at A-level is held. Equivalent of BBB or ABC in 3 A-level subjects (can be achieved over 3 years with a scoring adjustment).
graduate_a100.no_separate_graduate_entry_course: Graduates apply through the same A100 route, scored as a separate sub-group; no A101-style course exists at Leicester.

scoring_formula.components: Best 3 A-levels (or HL IB), must include Chemistry or Biology, plus degree classification, capped at 48.
scoring_formula.reason: The shared generic scoring components (gcse_mandatory_then_best, ucat_range_lookup, sjt_band_lookup, a_level_grade_points_scaled, academic_profile_matrix) do not support a combined best-3-A-level-plus-degree-classification-with-3-year-adjustment formula in one component; implementing a bespoke calculator would require an engine change under the architecture-freeze process. Graduate eligibility (2:1 minimum, GCSE gate, Chemistry/Biology B) is fully executable; graduate numeric ranking is manual review.

access_to_medicine.eligibility_gate: Must meet minimum GCSE requirements and have studied an approved Access to Medicine Diploma course. Not available to school leavers who could have done A-levels, nor as a fallback for poor science A-level results, nor for graduates with poor A-level results. Must be 22+ at registration with evidence of 5 years' paid employment or apprenticeship post-school, including at least 1 year in a relevant caring role. Full CV required by the UCAS 15 October deadline.
access_to_medicine.graduate_with_access_diploma_non_science: Scored under the GRADUATE formula instead of the Access formula.

distinction_ambiguity_resolution.detail: The general Access route requires the approved diploma; 'distinction in all graded credits' (usually 45 credits) is operationalised as the +8 bonus point in the Section 6.0 scoring formula, not as a blanket admission requirement, because Section 6.0 is more operationally precise for the executable rule.

gcse_component.double_science_alternative: Double Science may substitute for the Biology and Chemistry mandatory slots (2 slots).

non_science_a_level_bonus.condition: Only if the candidate has NOT studied full A-levels/equivalent.
non_science_a_level_bonus.scale: Up to 3 AS grades at A=3pts each (per-subject scale: A*/A=3, B=2, C=1), capped as part of the academic subtotal.

access_diploma_distinction_bonus.condition: Completed Access to Medicine Diploma with distinctions in ALL graded credits (usually 45 credits, older courses 60).

references_employment_component.scoring_method: Scored by 2 independent Admissions Tutors, each out of 5.

personal_statement_component.scoring_method: Scored by 2 independent Admissions Tutors, each out of 5.

scoring_formula.reason: The references/employment and personal-statement components (20 of 76 points) require two independent Admissions-Tutor human scores that ApplySmart does not compute; Access eligibility (diploma, minimum GCSEs, age/employment evidence, CV) is fully executable, numeric ranking is manual review.

minimum_threshold.detail: Bottom 2 deciles of that year's UCAT total-score distribution are excluded from scoring entirely (not scored at zero). Exact cutoff score is not fixed and moves each year with the cohort distribution; ApplySmart uses the shared data/ucat-deciles.json decile-2/3 boundary (1680) as the current-cycle exclusion threshold, reviewed annually.
minimum_threshold.boundary_source: data/ucat-deciles.json official 2025 UCAT Consortium decile thresholds

sjt.policy: SJT Band 4 is an automatic pre-interview rejection hard gate, applied regardless of UCAT total score.
sjt.mitigating_circumstances: UCAT mitigating circumstances are not normally accepted (self-declared fitness to sit); only invigilator-flagged test-day issues are considered. A UCAT bursary award is a contextual flag for borderline review, not a scoring input.

scoring_bandings.below_1800_note: Bands continue in the same approximately-1-point-per-50-point-band pattern below 1800, terminated by the bottom-2-decile exclusion rather than a fixed hardcoded lower band; not hardcoded per the task instruction not to invent unpublished numbers.

achieved_route_auto_interview_decile_thr.source: data/ucat-deciles.json shared national decile dataset, consistent with the pattern used by other universities in this engine for decile-based auto-interview thresholds.

historical_caveat.detail: UCAT was rescaled in summer 2025 (2700 max, was 3600) and Leicester's own combined-score scale changed from 64pt (pre-2026) to 96pt (2026 entry onward). Only 2026-entry combined-score thresholds are on the new comparable scale; this is the first cycle of directly comparable data. Multi-year trend confidence must be labelled Limited, not asserted from pre-2026 data, per the Evidence Confidence Standard. Current-cycle eligibility and selection-methodology confidence may still be Medium-to-High because those are fully published for 2027.

historical_admissions.guidance_status: These are the closest thing to an official current-cycle numeric interview threshold Leicester publishes, stated as 'minimum combined score to guarantee interview' for 2026 entry. Treated as official/current-cycle-adjacent evidence but flagged as single-year comparable data; not extrapolated forward as guaranteed for 2027.

interview_format_explanatory_only.delivery_mode_2027_plan: Face-to-face for Home, online for International, subject to change.
interview_format_explanatory_only.notes: Explanatory metadata only; does not affect pre-interview selection and is outside this engine's interview-coaching scope.

items: Offer selection / offer thresholds / interview-score-to-offer conversion (Sections 9-10 of the scoring document).
Raw UCAT averages/lowest scores of interviewed or offered candidates (not published, not invented).
Exact MMI station count (not published, not invented).
Offer-holder statistics for 2026 (pending, not published, not invented).

remaining_evidence_gaps.production_handling: Graduate eligibility is executable; numeric ranking and banding are manual review because the shared generic scoring engine does not support the combined best-3-A-level/HL-plus-degree-classification-with-3-year-adjustment formula.
Access eligibility is executable; numeric ranking and banding are manual review because 20 of 76 points require independent Admissions-Tutor human scoring.
Not published; stored as explanatory-only metadata, not invented.
Not published; only combined-score bands are used for guidance.
Not separately published; general GCSE-equivalent B/6 standard applies. Scottish route remains a manual-review boundary in the generic classifier for the joint Higher/Advanced Higher evaluation.
Not separately published beyond the overall HL/points requirement.
Assessed via ECCTIS case-by-case; routed to manual-review/ECCTIS-equivalence-required state, consistent with how other universities in this engine handle ECCTIS-only equivalence.
Existence of a mitigation allowance is confirmed but no fixed published bonus-point figure exists; implemented as a manual-review flag, not a scored value.
No combined worked example is published; both bonus tracks are represented individually and the total academic score is capped at 48 regardless of interaction.
Resolved by following Section 6.0's operational scoring treatment: diploma completion is the eligibility gate, distinction-in-all-credits is the +8 scoring bonus.

Historical multi-year trend confidence is Limited due to the 2025 UCAT rescale and Leicester's 2026 64pt-to-96pt scoring-scale change; only one year of directly comparable data exists. This is reflected in evidence-confidence metadata and result-card wording. Current-cycle eligibility and selection-methodology confidence remain higher.
